definitions.explanation: The act of gathering, organizing, and consolidating information, opinions, or tasks into a coherent whole. Also used for the role of coordinating people or processes.

examples.japanese: {意見|いけん}の{取|と}りまとめを{行|おこな}う。
{報告書|ほうこくしょ}の{取|と}りまとめは{来週|らいしゅう}までにお{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: Please have the report compiled by next week.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}で{出|で}た{様々|さまざま}な{意見|いけん}を{取|と}りまとめて、{最終|さいしゅう}{案|あん}を{作成|さくせい}した。
examples.english: I consolidated the various opinions that came up in the meeting and created a final proposal.

notes:
The noun form of the compound verb {取|と}りまとめる (to compile, to coordinate). Widely used in business and administrative contexts for the process of gathering and organizing information or coordinating tasks.

USAGE:
Very common in workplace Japanese. Often appears as {取|と}りまとめ{役|やく} (coordinator, person in charge of pulling things together). The verb form {取|と}りまとめる is equally common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {取|と}りまとめを{行|おこな}う — to carry out compilation/coordination
- {取|と}りまとめ{役|やく} — coordinator, organizer
- {意見|いけん}の{取|と}りまとめ — compilation of opinions
- {最終|さいしゅう}{取|と}りまとめ — final consolidation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- まとめ — summary (shorter, more casual)
- {集約|しゅうやく} — consolidation, aggregation (more formal)
- {調整|ちょうせい} — coordination, adjustment (focuses on balancing)
